front_content.text:
阅读片段：There are tools to compare one's DNA with others' to find distant relatives based on their genetic identification. These kinds of applications are generally accurate. It's relatively easy to tell whether two DNA samples belong to close relatives. With distant relatives, results become hazier.

比较检测近亲与远亲关系的结果：哪一种更容易判断？哪两个英文短语支持你的答案？

back_content.text: 近亲更容易判断。close relatives 对应 relatively easy；distant relatives 对应 hazier。
back_content.explanation: relatively easy 形容判断近亲关系，hazier 意为更模糊，形容远亲结果。因此不能把“远亲更准确”当作同义改写。

analysis_content.text: relatively easy 形容判断近亲关系，hazier 意为更模糊，形容远亲结果。因此不能把“远亲更准确”当作同义改写。
tips: 把每个评价词连到它修饰的对象，再比较谁高谁低。

阅读片段：Young women engineers are more accepted mostly because there are just more of them. Many women engineers hailed the benefits of their chosen career.

back_content.text:

Young women engineers are less accepted now because there are more of them.
The women who spoke about their career described it as having no benefits.
back_content.explanation: more accepted 是更被接纳，不是1的 less accepted。hailed the benefits 表示赞扬职业的益处，与2的 having no benefits 相反。其余说法没有把这两种变化或评价反转。

tips: 读人物评价时，把动词hailed与它后面的benefits一起理解。
